reviewed_by: Claude: classify Butler supervisor except handlers
reason: #1315 added ten except handlers in the Butler supervisor modules that the diagnostic blind-spot audit (run by the python job) reports as unclassified, so main fails the gate. Expected control flow is marked diagnostic-expected: the shell timeout (recorded as the audited timeout outcome), an already-exited process group, guardrail refusals that _refuse audits and re-raises, unparseable shell text treated as not read-only, and non-IP words. Real fallbacks now record a diagnostic: an unreadable operator ceiling policy (default used), a failed repo-forensics audit write, and a malformed operator-only pattern (still fails closed). Python selects the three Butler supervisor test files, which gain two regression tests for the new diagnostics, and the product index digest check.
exclusions: No frontend, native or browser behavior changed, so those layers are empty. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL. No full-suite approval.
